newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde April 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde April 8.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Israeli prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu says will keep on building settlements in the West Bank despite U.S. President Bill Clinton's urgings for conciliation in the Middle East.
-- Volvo may be interested in buying U.S.-based Renault subsidiary Mack Trucks, but Renault denies any plans to sell Mack.
-- Employment outlook for executives remains gloomy, study shows.
-- Airbus signs memorandum of understanding with Saab AB and Finavitec on studies for project of super-jumbo A3XX.
